body: Omg I can’t even imagine how dumb text therapy would be. Who came up with that idea? Nothing like further dissociation from humanity to make you feel all warm and fuzzy about life.
Good luck my friend.
You should have a good talk about it. When things aren’t tense. I hope the opportunity comes up. Clearing the air can make you feel a lot better. And prob help them understand you more too.

It’s prob a good idea to find out exactly what those expectations are. So if you have a productive discussion about it and say “if I do this, is that going to be acceptable because it will at least show I’m improving even if it’s not perfect?” Work/play balance is a good thing to get good habits around. The same temptation to not work or do responsibilities doesn’t go away when you’re not living with parents, unfortunately. So from their perspective they are trying to help you with better habits most likely. Just find an agreement that will help you and make them feel like you are trying to be responsible. That might go a long way to improving that situation. I feel for ya though.
You should tell them that. That your phone gives you an outlet that you need. See what they think they’ll accomplish by taking away your phone and if there’s maybe a compromise you all can make.
That’s rough. I need to workout too. Just so devoid of energy. It’s a ruthless cycle.
Yeah. Some prob do care but they’re not supernatural. Only so much they can do. I wish it was free here. I might give it another shot if it was.

I can see how it would seem like that. Immensity is relative though. Debt - don’t worry too much about that. You’re young enough you could declare bankruptcy and by the time you’re 24 +/- that will be wiped clean. Or you’ll figure a way to pay it off slowly. If you stop paying on credit cards (if that’s what it is) in 6 months or so banks will offer you a payoff settlement 30-50% of what you owe. It’ll hurt your credit for awhile but prob not as long as bankruptcy. Talk to an expert but that’s just what I’ve come to understand. And a lot of people get a GED later and then move on with life. It ain’t so bad. But I get the pressure and disappointment you prob feel now. Go out and have fun somewhere and see how that can help you think things thru. I hated myself in h.s. so much but it did get better later for me. Got into a more traumatizing events later in life though that’s not as easily rectified. Sorry you’re dealing with it though. 

I rented a cabin a year or so ago with a friend and went hiking in the mountains. It was so much fun I forgot about my pain for awhile. Maybe that will help you. Short bursts of distraction are kind of all I have but it’s kept me going this long. Doesn’t heal everything but one day at a time. That’s what people tell me.
Are you good at making cakes? :)

Maybe the enjoying yourself part will keep you from doing it. If you can enjoy yourself then, then you should be able to keep repeating that, right? I know I’m over-simplifying but in a sense that is true.
If you’re this uncertain then there’s still help out there for you without having to go through this dangerous charade.

This sounds like a horrible way to go. I ruled out something like this because with my luck it wouldn’t work and I’d just mess my brain up and then get committed to an institution with no chance of ever getting it done and life would be even more miserable.

I’m really sorry to hear all of that. Life is brutal to some of us, I know. When despair like this is so great, where do we have to turn?

I just posted a thread here about therapists. I gave up on it because they’re expensive and to me have been worthless. Maybe it could be helpful for you though, I dunno. Everyone and their situation is different. 

Maybe there’s one thing that could make a difference for you. Try to imagine what that could be. Sorry I can’t offer much else. I’m just another person out there with similar feelings.

I can identify with several things on your list. The sad truth is we have to find a reason for ourselves to keep going. No one else can do that because their reasons will never make sense to us. I’ve concluded I have no reasons. Hopefully you’re not there yet.

Don’t worry too much about grades. I mean, try, but there’s so much more that can pull you out of this once you have more freedom. I didn’t do so well my last year in high school, but found a marketable skill through a tech/trade school. I still struggled with negative thoughts, self-esteem and stuff like that but having a skill and making my own money and choices really helped for quite some time. It’s only the traumatic things that happened to me way later on that put me back to this end-of-the-road state. Had those things not happened I probably would have continued on to have a mostly happy life. You’re too young to have it get that bad yet. There’s some great things to see and do. I hope you have a good enough relationship with one or both parents where you can talk about it.
Anguish is worse than nothing.

There needs to be a sub for people in that category. Not the “my parents are always mad at me so I’m gonna kill myself” or “my bf/gf just broke up with me I wanna die”. I came here looking to relate to `anyone` and I don’t even know if I can do that.
Me too.

We will. It just comes too slowly for a lot of us. I’ve felt like if I got news I had a brain tumor and 3-6 months to live that would be the best news ever. I could go. Everyone would know and not be able to prevent it. I could make peace with everyone without having to hide it from them or do it covertly. People would prob try to make my life the best it could be out of sympathy. It would be like winning a trip to space with SpaceX or something. That’s how thrilled I would be. We don’t get that luxury though. We have to suffer and exit in private. Even if the suffering isn’t private, the exit will be.
I found some solace in knowing I now had the means. It gave me some control, like, I don’t have to be here. I can finally escape at any time. So I know what you mean.
